title: cfs media frame
description: A square-cornered photo slot with an optional 3px orange rule along its bottom edge; empty, it shows a flat muted placeholder at the given aspect ratio.
notes: size it with className (aspect-[3/2], w-full…); the media fills it like object-fit: cover
name: cfs-media

props.name: media
props.description: an or

props.name: rule
props.description: draw the 3px orange rule along the bottom edge

props.name: tone
props.description: "photo": a muted surface; "drawing": a faint dashed outline (for line art on the page colour)
